# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

```{r}
bcr_data <- airr::read_rearrangement(file.path(Input_data, "Merged_Runs_all_contig_igblast_db-pass.tsv"),
```

# 3. AIRR data filtering

```{r}
bcr_data <- bcr_data %>% dplyr::filter(productive)
cat(paste("There are", nrow(bcr_data), "rows in the data.\n"))
```

```{r}
## Early filtering
# Remove cells with multiple heavy chains
multi_heavy <- table(dplyr::filter(bcr_data, locus == "IGH")$cell_id)
multi_heavy_cells <- names(multi_heavy)[multi_heavy > 1]

bcr_data <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, !cell_id %in% multi_heavy_cells)
cat(paste("There are", nrow(bcr_data),
          "rows in the data after filtering out cells with multiple heavy chains.\n"))
```

```{r}
# Remove cells with multiple light chains
multi_light <- table(dplyr::filter(bcr_data, locus == "IGK" | locus == "IGL")$cell_id)
multi_light_cells <- names(multi_light)[multi_light > 1]

bcr_data <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, !cell_id %in% multi_light_cells)
cat(paste("There are", nrow(bcr_data),
          "rows in the data after filtering out cells with multiple light chains.\n"))
```

```{r}
# Split cells by heavy and light chains and identify unpaired cells
heavy_cells <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, locus == "IGH")$cell_id
light_cells <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, locus == "IGK" | locus == "IGL")$cell_id
no_heavy_cells <- light_cells[which(!light_cells %in% heavy_cells)]
no_light_cells <- heavy_cells[which(!heavy_cells %in% light_cells)]
```

```{r}
# Removed cells with no heavy chain
bcr_data <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, !cell_id %in% no_heavy_cells)
cat(paste("There are", nrow(bcr_data), "rows in the data after filtering out
          cells without heavy chains."))
```


```{r}
# Removed cells with no light chain
bcr_data <- dplyr::filter(bcr_data, !cell_id %in% no_light_cells)
cat(paste("There are", nrow(bcr_data), "rows in the data after filtering out
          cells without light chains."))
```

# 4. Clonal Analysis

## - Single-cell mode

```{r}
# Group cells in a one-stage process (VJthenLen=FALSE) and using
# Both heavy and light chain sequences (onlyHeavy=FALSE)
dist_nearest <- shazam::distToNearest(bcr_data, cellIdColumn="cell_id", locusColumn="locus", 
                         VJthenLen=FALSE, onlyHeavy=FALSE)
```

```{r}
# View dist_nearest values
str(dist_nearest)
```

```{r}
# Generate Hamming distance histogram
p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(subset(dist_nearest, !is.na(dist_nearest)),
                      aes(x = dist_nearest)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white", binwidth = 0.02) +
  labs(x = "Hamming distance", y = "Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))
plot(p1)
```

```{r}
# Find threshold for cloning automatically
threshold_output <- shazam::findThreshold(dist_nearest$dist_nearest,
                                          method = "gmm", model = "gamma-norm",
                                          cutoff = "user", spc = 0.995)
threshold <- threshold_output@threshold
threshold


plot(threshold_output, binwidth = 0.02, silent = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))
```

```{r}
# Call clones using hierarchicalClones
results <- scoper::hierarchicalClones(bcr_data,
                              cell_id = "cell_id",
                              threshold = threshold,
                              only_heavy = TRUE, 
                              split_light = TRUE,
                              summarize_clones = FALSE)

# View clone_ids
str(results)
```

# 6. Work out extra sequencing info

## - Fix v_start

```{r}
# Function to adjust v_sequence_start based on the number of dots at the beginning of sequence_alignment
adjust_sequence_start <- function(sequence_alignment, v_sequence_start) {
  starts_with_dot <- grepl("^\\.", sequence_alignment)  # Check if sequence_alignment starts with a dot
  num_dots <- ifelse(starts_with_dot, nchar(sub("^(\\.+).*", "\\1", sequence_alignment)), 0)  # Count number of dots at the beginning
  v_sequence_start <- v_sequence_start - num_dots  # Adjust v_sequence_start for rows starting with a dot
  v_sequence_start[v_sequence_start < 1] <- 1  # Ensure v_sequence_start is not less than 1
  return(v_sequence_start)
}
```


```{r}
# Apply the function to relevant columns
results$v_sequence_start <- adjust_sequence_start(results$sequence_alignment, results$v_sequence_start)
```

## - Extract vdj, vj, dj, v, d and j sequences

```{r}
# Create new columns for V, D, and J sequences
results$v_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$v_sequence_start, results$v_sequence_end)
results$d_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$d_sequence_start, results$d_sequence_end)
results$j_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$j_sequence_start, results$j_sequence_end)
```


```{r}
# Create new column for VJD sequence, VD, DJ and VJ 
results$vdj_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$v_sequence_start, results$j_sequence_end)
results$vd_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$v_sequence_end + 1, results$d_sequence_start - 1)
results$dj_sequence <- substr(results$sequence, results$d_sequence_end + 1, results$j_sequence_start - 1)
```


```{r}
# Check if locus is IGH
is_IGH <- results$locus == "IGH"
```


```{r}
# Create a new column 'vj_sequence' with NA for rows where locus is IGH
results$vj_sequence <- ifelse(is_IGH, NA, substr(results$sequence, results$v_sequence_end + 1, results$j_sequence_start - 1))
```

## - Translate vdj sequences

```{r}
# Define a function to translate DNA sequence to amino acids
translate_dna_to_aa <- function(sequence) {
  aa_seq <- translate(DNAString(sequence))
  return(as.character(aa_seq))
}
```

```{r}
# Apply the translation function to the vdj_sequence column
results$amino_acid_sequence <- sapply(results$vdj_sequence, translate_dna_to_aa)
```

```{r}
## work out germline vdj, vj, v, d and j sequences
# Function to remove '.' from a string
remove_dot <- function(x) {
  gsub("\\.", "", x)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to remove '-' from a string
remove_minus <- function(x) {
  gsub("\\-", "", x)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply the function to the 'germline_alignment' column and create a new column 'germline_sequence'
results$vdj_germline_sequence <- remove_dot(results$germline_alignment)
```

```{r}
# Create a new column `v_germline_sequence` by taking characters from the start of `germline_alignment`
results$v_germline_sequence <- substr(results$germline_alignment, 1, results$v_germline_length)
```

```{r}
# Calculate the start position for extracting characters
start_position <- results$v_germline_length + nchar(results$vd_sequence) + 1
```

```{r}
# Create a new column `d_germline_sequence` by taking characters from the calculated start position of `germline_alignment`
results$d_germline_sequence <- mapply(function(germline_alignment, start_position, d_germline_length) {
  substr(germline_alignment, start_position, start_position + d_germline_length - 1)
}, results$germline_alignment, start_position, results$d_germline_length)
```

```{r}
# Calculate the start position for extracting characters from the end of `germline_alignment`
start_position <- nchar(results$germline_alignment) - results$j_germline_length + 1
```

```{r}
# Create a new column `j_germline_sequence` by taking characters from the calculated start position of `germline_alignment`
results$j_germline_sequence <- substr(results$germline_alignment, start_position, start_position + results$j_germline_length - 1)
```

## - Identify inserts, deletions and indels

```{r}
# Function to remove dots (if present)
remove_dot <- function(seq) gsub("\\.", "", seq)
```

```{r}
# Remove dots from sequences and alignment
results$v_germline_sequence <- remove_dot(results$v_germline_sequence)
results$v_sequence <- remove_dot(results$v_sequence)
results$sequence_alignment <- remove_dot(results$sequence_alignment)
```

```{r}
# Classify sequences
results <- results %>%
  mutate(indel = case_when(
    str_detect(sequence_alignment, "-") ~ "Indel",               # any gap
    !str_detect(sequence_alignment, "-") & 
      (nchar(v_sequence) > nchar(v_germline_sequence)) ~ "Insertion",  # longer sequence without gap
    TRUE ~ ""  # everything else
  ))
```

# 7. Reformat data

```{r}
### ================================
### HEAVY CHAIN (IGH)
### ================================

# Filter IGH
results_IGH_2 <- subset(results, locus == "IGH")

# Select columns
results_IGH <- results_IGH_2[, c(
  "sequence_id", "cell_id", "vdj_sequence", "amino_acid_sequence",
  "v_call", "d_call", "j_call", "c_call",
  "v_identity", "d_identity", "j_identity",
  "v_score", "d_score", "j_score",
  "clone_id", "np1_length", "np2_length",
  "fwr1", "fwr2", "fwr3", "fwr4",
  "cdr1", "cdr2", "cdr3",
  "v_sequence", "d_sequence", "j_sequence",
  "vd_sequence", "dj_sequence", "junction",
  "vdj_germline_sequence", "v_germline_sequence",
  "d_germline_sequence", "j_germline_sequence",
  "indel"
)]

# Rename columns
names(results_IGH) <- c(
  "sequence_id_heavy", "cell_id", "vdj_sequence_heavy",
  "amino_acid_sequence_heavy", "v_gene_heavy",
  "d_gene_heavy", "j_gene_heavy", "c_gene_heavy",
  "v_identity_heavy", "d_identity_heavy", "j_identity_heavy",
  "v_score_heavy", "d_score_heavy", "j_score_heavy",
  "clone_id", "np1_length_heavy", "np2_length_heavy",
  "fwr1_sequence_heavy", "fwr2_sequence_heavy",
  "fwr3_sequence_heavy", "fwr4_sequence_heavy",
  "cdr1_sequence_heavy", "cdr2_sequence_heavy", "cdr3_sequence_heavy",
  "v_sequence_heavy", "d_sequence_heavy", "j_sequence_heavy",
  "vd_sequence_heavy", "dj_sequence_heavy", "junction_sequence_heavy",
  "vdj_germline_sequence_heavy", "v_germline_sequence_heavy",
  "d_germline_sequence_heavy", "j_germline_sequence_heavy",
  "indel_heavy"
)

# Clean FWR / CDR sequences
for (col in c(
  "fwr1_sequence_heavy", "fwr2_sequence_heavy",
  "fwr3_sequence_heavy", "fwr4_sequence_heavy",
  "cdr1_sequence_heavy", "cdr2_sequence_heavy", "cdr3_sequence_heavy"
)) {
  results_IGH[[col]] <- remove_minus(remove_dot(results_IGH[[col]]))
}
```

```{r}
### ================================
### LIGHT CHAIN (IGK / IGL)
### ================================

# Filter IGK / IGL
results_IGK_IGL_2 <- subset(results, locus %in% c("IGK", "IGL"))

# Select columns
results_IGK_IGL <- results_IGK_IGL_2[, c(
  "sequence_id", "cell_id", "vdj_sequence", "amino_acid_sequence",
  "v_call", "j_call", "c_call",
  "v_identity", "j_identity",
  "v_score", "j_score",
  "clone_id", "np1_length",
  "fwr1", "fwr2", "fwr3", "fwr4",
  "cdr1", "cdr2", "cdr3",
  "v_sequence", "j_sequence", "vj_sequence",
  "junction",
  "vdj_germline_sequence", "v_germline_sequence", "j_germline_sequence",
  "indel"
)]

# Rename columns
names(results_IGK_IGL) <- c(
  "sequence_id_light", "cell_id", "vdj_sequence_light",
  "amino_acid_sequence_light", "v_gene_light",
  "j_gene_light", "c_gene_light",
  "v_identity_light", "j_identity_light",
  "v_score_light", "j_score_light",
  "clone_id", "np1_length_light",
  "fwr1_sequence_light", "fwr2_sequence_light",
  "fwr3_sequence_light", "fwr4_sequence_light",
  "cdr1_sequence_light", "cdr2_sequence_light", "cdr3_sequence_light",
  "v_sequence_light", "j_sequence_sequence_light",
  "vj_sequence_sequence_light", "junction_sequence_light",
  "vdj_germline_sequence_light", "v_germline_sequence_light",
  "j_germline_sequence_light",
  "indel_light"
)

# Clean FWR / CDR sequences
for (col in c(
  "fwr1_sequence_light", "fwr2_sequence_light",
  "fwr3_sequence_light", "fwr4_sequence_light",
  "cdr1_sequence_light", "cdr2_sequence_light", "cdr3_sequence_light"
)) {
  results_IGK_IGL[[col]] <- remove_minus(remove_dot(results_IGK_IGL[[col]]))
}
```

```{r}
### ================================
### MERGE HEAVY + LIGHT
### ================================

results <- merge(
  results_IGH,
  results_IGK_IGL,
  by = c("cell_id", "clone_id")
)


### Look at mutation frequency on clones
# Calculate the median mutation frequency of a clone using 100 - (100 * v_identity)
mut_freq_clone <- results %>%
  group_by(clone_id) %>%
  summarize(median_mut_freq = median((1 - v_identity_heavy)))


ggplot(mut_freq_clone, aes(median_mut_freq)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.005) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))


# Plotting mu_freq by isotype
ggplot2::ggplot(results, aes(y = ((1 - v_identity_heavy)*100), x = c_gene_heavy, fill = c_gene_heavy)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "", y = "% Mutation", fill = "Isotype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

# Exporting to excel file
write.csv(results, file.path(Input_data, 'BCR_with_clonotypes.csv'))
```
